stem: Periodontitis is found in a pediatric patient. Which statement best describes how the clinician should approach the diagnosis?

options.text: Attribute the disease to local factors alone and leave systemic conditions out of the differential.
Consider systemic effects only in adults, because pediatric periodontium is unaffected by medical conditions.
Consider medications only, because medical diseases do not influence periodontal health.
Include medical conditions that affect periodontal health in the differential diagnosis.
